Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — Stratify is happy to move forward with the 2x Dedicated GPU pool add-on as part of our renewal (term start 2028-09-01). Attached is our official PO (RDW-7845) and an updated W-9 for your records.

Couple of asks so we can complete procurement on our side:
- Can Redwood issue the renewal invoice referencing PO RDW-7845?
- Please send the invoice to: Stratify Analytics, Attn: Finance Ops, invoices@stratify.ai (we may move to accounts-payable@ later; we'll confirm)
- Our procurement requires Net60 payment terms (we budget on Net60 for renewals). Please confirm if Redwood can accept Net60 for this amendment.

We'd like capacity to start provisioning in the week of Aug 15, so if you can confirm those items and return an invoice we can route payment quickly.

Marissa — can you confirm we've queued the provisioning hold and mark deal RDW-7845 as "awaiting PO" in HubSpot?
